title: Sunflower Power Sequence
description: Four sequential poses of a young female anime character with spiky black hair and sunflower accessories, set against a solid green background. She wears a yellow and black outfit with a belt, boots, and a long black tail, progressively generating increasingly intense glowing yellow energy and sunflower petals from her hands.
